summary: Clene Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an underwritten public offering of 1,000,000 common shares at $7.00 per share, raising $7.0 million gross ($6.545 million net). The offering is a routine shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration statement, not a special situation. The shares trade on Nasdaq under CLNN, and the offering closed on May 6, 2026. Canaccord Genuity acted as sole bookrunner. The filing lacks any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change elements.
